'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Emerson Sklar DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Emerson Sklar]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''EOPS'''. Shield 6 is struck through and not replaced, so 11 shields are listed. Transcription notes: Line 57 written ''Sandos/Fandos (one word)''. Lines shown in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card could not be identified for certain.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Username:''' Sklarface
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
